arxiv-1604-06285.title: A Novel Approach to Dropped Pronoun Translation
arxiv-1604-06285.creator: Longyue Wang † Zhaopeng Tu ‡ Xiaojun Zhang † Hang Li ‡ Andy Way † Qun Liu †
arxiv-1604-06285.description: Abstract Dropped Pronouns (DP) in which pronouns are frequently dropped in the source language but should be retained in the target language are challenge in machine translation. In response to this problem, we propose a semi-supervised approach to recall possibly missing pronouns in the translation.

arxiv-1701-06890.title: Anisotropic inflation in Brans-Dicke gravity
arxiv-1701-06890.creator: M. Tirandari, Kh. Saaidi
arxiv-1701-06890.description: Abstract We study anisotropic inflation in the Brans-Dicke gravity in the presence of an abelian gauge field where the gauge field is non-minimally coupled to the inflaton. We show that the degree of anisotropy, under slow-roll approximations, is proportional to slow-roll parameter of the theory. As a demonstration, we consider the displaced quadratic potential for the inflation.

arxiv-2102-11313.title: Microscopic derivation of Dirac composite fermion theory: Aspects of noncommutativity and pairing instabilities
arxiv-2102-11313.creator: Dragoljub Gočanin, Sonja Predin, Marija Dimitrijević Ćirić, Voja Radovanović, Milica Milovanović
arxiv-2102-11313.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Dragoljub Gočanin, Sonja Predin, Marija Dimitrijević Ćirić, Voja Radovanović, Milica Milovanović. Building on previous work [N. Senthil, 16262 (1998); Phys. B 102 , 205126 (2020)] on the system of bosons at filling factor ν = 1 \nu=1 , we derive the Dirac composite fermion theory for a half-filled Landau level from first principles and applying the Hartree-Fock approach in a preferred representation.

arxiv-2107-07607.title: An epsilon-near-zero-based Dallenbach absorber
arxiv-2107-07607.creator: Viacheslav V. Medvedev
arxiv-2107-07607.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Viacheslav V. Medvedev. We report a theoretical analysis of total absorption conditions in a structure consisting of a lossy coating layer on top of a specular metal substrate, which is known as a Dallenbach absorber. All possible combinations of complex refractive indices of the coating material and thicknesses of the coating layer providing complete absorption are described for the case of normal incidence of a plane wave. The work of coatings based on epsilon-near-zero (ENZ) materials is analyzed in detail.

arxiv-2204-12036.title: Adaptive Pseudo-Siamese Policy Network for Temporal Knowledge Prediction
arxiv-2204-12036.creator: Pengpeng Shao 1,2 , Tong Liu 1 , Feihu Che 1,2 , Dawei Zhang 1 , Jianhua Tao 1,2,3
arxiv-2204-12036.description: Abstract Temporal knowledge prediction is a crucial task for the event early warning that has gained increasing attention in recent years, which aims to predict the future facts by using relevant historical facts on the temporal knowledge graphs. There are two main difficulties in this prediction task.

arxiv-2212-06748.title: A smoothed semiparametric likelihood for estimation of nonparametric finite mixture models with a copula-based dependence structure
arxiv-2212-06748.creator: Michael Levine, Gildas Mazo
arxiv-2212-06748.description: Abstract In this manuscript, we consider a finite multivariate nonparametric mixture model where the dependence between the marginal densities is modeled using the copula device. Pseudo EM stochastic algorithms were recently proposed to estimate all of the components of this model under a location-scale constraint on the marginals.

arxiv-2309-13282.title: Convective Heat Transfer in Porous Materials
arxiv-2309-13282.creator: Peng Jin, Gaole Dai, Fubao Yang
arxiv-2309-13282.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Peng Jin, Gaole Dai, Fubao Yang. Thermal convection stands out as an exceptionally efficient thermal transport mechanism, distinctly separate from conduction and radiation. Yet, the inherently elusive nature of fluid motion poses challenges in accurately controlling convective heat flow. While recent innovations have harnessed thermal convection to achieve effective thermal conductivity, fusing thermal convection in liquids and thermal conduction in solids together to form hybrid thermal metamaterials is still challenging. In this review, we introduce the latest progress in convective heat transfer.

arxiv-2402-01313.title: AutoGCN - Towards Generic Human Activity Recognition with Neural Architecture Search
arxiv-2402-01313.creator: Felix Tempel, Inga Strümke, Espen Alexander F. Ihlen
arxiv-2402-01313.description: Abstract This paper introduces AutoGCN, a generic Neural Architecture Search (NAS) algorithm for Human Activity Recognition (HAR) using Graph Convolution Networks (GCNs). HAR has enjoyed increased attention due to advances in deep learning, increased data availability, and enhanced computational capabilities. Concurrently, GCNs have shown promising abilities in modeling relationships between body key points in a skeletal graph.

arxiv-2405-00937.title: New bounds on the cohesion of complete-link and other linkage methods for agglomeration clustering
arxiv-2405-00937.creator: Sanjoy Dasgupta, Eduardo S. Laber
arxiv-2405-00937.description: Abstract Linkage methods are among the most popular algorithms for hierarchical clustering. Despite their relevance the current knowledge regarding the quality of the clustering produced by these methods is limited. Here, we improve the currently available bounds on the maximum diameter of the clustering obtained by complete-linkage for metric spaces.

arxiv-2405-03899.title: Modeling and performance analysis of Implicit Electric Field Conjugation with two deformable mirrors applied to the Roman Coronagraph
arxiv-2405-03899.creator: Kian Milani, Ewan S. Douglas, Sebastiaan Y. Haffert, Kyle Van Gorkom
arxiv-2405-03899.description: Abstract High-order wavefront sensing and control (HOWFSC) is key to create a dark hole region within the coronagraphic image plane where high contrasts are achieved. The Roman Coronagraph is expected to perform its HOWFSC with a ground-in-the-loop scheme due to the computational complexity of the Electric Field Conjugation (EFC) algorithm.

arxiv-2503-01605.title: A Leaf-Level Dataset for Soybean–Cotton Detection and Segmentation
arxiv-2503-01605.creator: Thiago H. Segreto, Juliano Negri, Paulo H. Polegato, João Manoel Herrera Pinheiro, Ricardo V. Godoy, Marcelo Becker
arxiv-2503-01605.description: Abstract Soybean and cotton are major drivers of many countries’ agricultural sectors, offering substantial economic returns but also facing persistent challenges from volunteer plants and weeds that hamper sustainable management. Effectively controlling volunteer plants and weeds demands advanced recognition strategies that can identify these amidst complex crop canopies.

arxiv-2511-04078.title: Unveiling Deep Semantic Uncertainty Perception for Language-Anchored Multi-modal Vision-Brain Alignment
arxiv-2511-04078.creator: Zehui Feng, Chenqi Zhang, Mingru Wang, Minuo Wei, Shiwei Cheng, Cuntai Guan, Ting Han
arxiv-2511-04078.description: Abstract Unveiling visual semantics from neural signals such as EEG, MEG, and fMRI remains a fundamental challenge due to subject variability and the entangled nature of visual features. Existing approaches primarily align neural activity directly with visual embeddings, but visual-only representations often fail to capture latent semantic dimensions, limiting interpretability and deep robustness.

arxiv-2602-06813.title: Bergman metric on a Stein manifold with nonpositive constant holomorphic sectional curvature
arxiv-2602-06813.creator: Xiaojun Huang, Song-Ying Li
arxiv-2602-06813.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Xiaojun Huang, Song-Ying Li. We prove that the Bergman space of a Stein manifold separates points whenever its Bergman metric is well defined and has non-positive constant holomorphic sectional curvature. This, combined with early proved results, shows that a Stein manifold cannot admit a well-defined flat Bergman metric, and that it has a well-defined Bergman metric with negative constant holomorphic sectional curvature if and only if it is biholomorphic to the unit ball of the same dimensin possibly with a pluri-polar set removed.

pmc-11401127.title: Insights into the environmental benefits of using apple pomace for biosorption of lead from contaminated water
pmc-11401127.creator: Gabriela Ungureanu, Iuliana-Maria Enache, Irina Gabriela Cara, Iuliana Motrescu, Antoanela Patras
pmc-11401127.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). The apple processing industry generates large quantities of organic waste, presenting a major source of organic contamination. Consequently, finding an effective solution for valorizing this waste has become a pressing issue. This study aims to address two key concerns: (i) solving an agricultural problem by efficiently using agri-food residue, and (ii) removing lead, an extremely toxic element, from contaminated waters to mitigate environmental pollution.

pmc-11579589.title: A digital health-supported and community pharmacy-based lifestyle intervention program for adults with pre-diabetes: a study protocol for a cluster randomised controlled trial
pmc-11579589.creator: Kah Woon Teoh, Choon Ming Ng, Chun Wie Chong, Wing Loong Cheong, Yi Ling Ng, J Simon Bell, Shaun Wen Huey Lee
pmc-11579589.description: IntroductionPre-diabetes indicates an elevated risk of developing type-2 diabetes and presents a window for preventive actions. The Pre-diabetes Intervention, Management and Evaluation (PRIME) programme is a community pharmacy-based pre-diabetes management programme that uses a mobile application for self-monitoring and pre-diabetes education, aiming to promote lifestyle changes among participants with pre-diabetes.

pmc-12577874.title: From past to future: a comprehensive scientometric perspective of influential studies on pterygium
pmc-12577874.creator: Zhimin Gu, Liang Lv, Ruo Qi, Lei Shi, Like Guan, Xin Liu, Lixiao Zhou
pmc-12577874.description: Background:Pterygium is a relatively common ocular surface disease. Although treatment methods have been studied for a long time, pathogenesis remains unclear. We aimed to explore the research activity and future trends of influential studies from a scientometric perspective.Methods:We performed the search in Web of Science Core Collection (WoSCC) for accessible articles on pterygium from 1945 to 2024.

pmc-12817659.title: Combination forecasting of COVID-19 in Bangladesh: guiding public health policy through integrated time series, ML, and DL models
pmc-12817659.creator: Sharmin Akther, Amartay Kumar Dhar, Jakia Sultana Pingky
pmc-12817659.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundAccurate prediction of trends in infectious diseases is crucial for early public health actions, which are difficult to achieve in low-resource countries such as Bangladesh, where the healthcare system is significantly challenged. Although many researchers worldwide have utilized machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL) models for making COVID-19 predictions, limited research has focused on context-specific ensemble forecasting approaches for Bangladesh, creating a gap in local epidemic modeling.
